rules.statement: weekdays (Monday-Friday, Beijing time) keep the peak/off-peak split; weekends (Saturday-Sunday, Beijing time) bill uniformly at the off-peak rate
citation: deepseek team email to the maintainer, received 2026-08-22

rules.statement: GLM-5.3-Flash bills at a 50% discount on its list prices until 2026-09-09 24:00 (UTC+8): input $0.075, cached input $0.015, output $0.25 per 1M tokens; the struck-through figures ($0.15 / $0.03 / $0.50) are list prices
Regional processing (data residency) endpoints are charged a 10% uplift for models released on or after March 5, 2026, that are eligible for data residency; the index stores the base rates

five serverless models are deprecated effective 2026-08-27: MiniMax M2.7, GPT OSS 20B, Kimi K2.6 Turbo and Fast, Kimi K2.7 Code Fast, DeepSeek V4 Pro. migrations: MiniMax M3, GPT OSS 120B or Qwen3 8B, Kimi K2.6, Kimi K2.7 Code, DeepSeek V4 Pro (0813). the pricing page dropped these five plus glm-5.3-fast by 2026-08-30 (observed live); their removal rows land through the absence machinery

glm coding plan quota consumption multipliers, not prices: GLM-5.3 consumes 1x off-peak / 3x peak, GLM-5.3-Flash 0.4x off-peak / 1.2x peak; peak hours Monday-Friday 14:00-18:00 SGT (UTC+8). the index stores the multipliers as typed window_rates entries; consumers never price sessions from them

kimi-k2.5 and all moonshot-v1 series models (including the -vision-preview ids and moonshot-v1-auto) retired across all platforms at 16:00 on 2026-08-31; calls to these models now return a 404 'model not found' error; migrate to Kimi K3. the changelog names no timezone for the 16:00 hour; Asia/Shanghai is inferred (moonshot is a Beijing company). the stored rows get removal rows through the absence machinery

gemini-3.8-flash is generally available from 2026-09-02. the paid-tier standard rates ($0.75 input / $0.075 cache read / $3.75 output per 1M tokens) apply through 2026-12-31, then step to $1.50 / $0.15 / $7.50 starting 2027-01-01 (the batch tier halves input and output and quarters cache read). the pricing page names no timezone for the boundary; the index stores the in-force intro rates

the changelog gained a 'Multimodal Model Deprecation Notice' dated 2026-09-30; the fetched snapshot carries only the entry title, no model list or terms. the page names no timezone; UTC is the recorded frame. re-read the entry prose at the effective date

the release notes deprecate Kimi K2.5, GLM 5, GLM-5.1 and Nemotron-3-Super-120B (Public Preview) from DigitalOcean Inference as of 8 September 2026, with migrations: Kimi K2.5 to Kimi K3 (kimi-k3), GLM 5 and GLM-5.1 to GLM-5.3 (glm-5.3), Nemotron-3-Super-120B to Nemotron 3 Ultra (nemotron-3-ultra-550b). the page names no timezone; UTC is the recorded frame

the changelog removes openai/gpt-oss-20b, google/gemma-4-31B-it, thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small and intfloat/multilingual-e5-large-instruct from serverless on 2026-09-14, recommending Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B for gpt-oss-20b and zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash for gemma-4-31B-it and Inkling-Small; all except intfloat/multilingual-e5-large-instruct stay available through on-demand dedicated endpoints. the page names no timezone; UTC is the recorded frame

the perplexity Agent API supports google/gemini-3.8-flash at promotional pricing through 2026-12-31: $0.75 per million uncached-input tokens, $0.075 per million cached-input tokens, and $3.75 per million output and reasoning tokens (the pricing page's Agent API table shows the same rates). the changelog names no post-promo rates; UTC is the recorded frame. no store row lands: the perplexity detector watches the sonar Token Pricing table only, and the model sits in the Agent API table

the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash release updates retire the previous-generation models V4 Flash and V4 Flash Vision Exp (the model names deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp are temporarily routed to V4.1 Flash) and retire V4 Pro in an orderly manner: after 12:00 Beijing Time on 2026-09-14, and until the future release of V4.1 Pro, all requests to deepseek-v4-pro are routed to V4.1 Flash and billed at the V4.1 Flash price; API prices are reduced accordingly with the release

the 2026-09-10 entry was amended to rescind the V4 Pro retirement: in response to user demand, deepseek continues providing API services for deepseek-v4-pro after 2026-09-14, with the billing method remaining unchanged, superseding the v4-pro routing clause of deepseek-v4-retirement-2026-09-10 (after 12:00 Beijing Time on 2026-09-14, requests to deepseek-v4-pro would have been routed to V4.1 Flash and billed at the V4.1 Flash price); the V4 Flash / V4 Flash Vision Exp retirement and temporary routing to V4.1 Flash stand unchanged; further notice promised should anything change

the changelog decommissions seven older Serverless models on 2026-09-25, with migrations: DeepSeek V4 Flash (0731), DeepSeek V4 Pro (0813) and DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Exp to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GLM 5.2 to GLM 5.3, Muse Glimmer 30B to NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B A3B, Kimi K2.6 and Kimi K2.7 Code to GLM 5.3 or Kimi K3. it applies only to serverless endpoints, including the Fast and US-only Serverless variants; dedicated deployments are unaffected. the page names no timezone; UTC is the recorded frame. the stored rows get removal rows through the absence machinery

on 2026-10-01 at 00:00 UTC serverless pricing for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash changes (uncached input / cached input / output per 1M tokens): Standard $0.22 / $0.007 / $0.66 to $0.30 / $0.006 / $1.20, Priority $0.275 / $0.00875 / $0.825 to $0.375 / $0.0075 / $1.50; dedicated deployments and Reserved Throughput are unaffected. the pricing page already shows the new Standard rates, so the stored row carries them with effective_at = 2026-10-01

Novita retires 32 models from its platform in two batches on 2026-09-29 and 2026-10-09, with no replacement models: deepseek/deepseek-v3.2, deepseek/deepseek-r1, deepseek/deepseek-v3.1, deepseek/deepseek-v3.1-terminus, deepseek/deepseek-v3.2-exp, deepseek/deepseek-r1-distill-llama-70b (Sep 29); qwen/qwen3.6-plus, qwen/qwen3-vl-235b-a22b-instruct, openai/gpt-oss-20b, deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp, qwen/qwen3-coder-30b-a3b-instruct, qwen/qwen3-coder-480b-a35b-instruct, qwen/qwen3-coder-next, qwen/qwen-2.5-72b-instruct, qwen/qwen3-next-80b-a3b-instruct, qwen/qwen3.5-plus, sao10k/l31-70b-euryale-v2.2, qwen/qwen3-vl-235b-a22b-thinking, qwen/qwen3-max, mistralai/mistral-nemo, sao10k/l3-8b-lunaris, zai-org/glm-5v-turbo, qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-thinking-2507, baidu/ernie-4.5-vl-424b-a47b, minimax/minimax-m2, qwen/qwen3-omni-30b-a3b-instruct, minimax/minimax-m2.1, zai-org/glm-5-turbo, minimax/minimax-m2.5-highspeed, qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-fp8, qwen/qwen3-embedding-0.6b, thudm/glm-4-32b-0414 (Oct 9); applications must stop sending requests before each cutoff
